#  Keeper – Unified AWS Infrastructure (Serverless Framework v4)
#
#  Covers all four features in one deploy command:
#    Feature 1 – Zero-Trust Vault              (S3 bucket + IAM)
#    Feature 2 – Link Detonator                (S3 staging bucket + Lambda)
#    Feature 3 – Ephemeral Chat                (WebSocket + Lambda + DynamoDB)
#    Feature 4 – Secure Cloud Storage Room     (S3 + DynamoDB + Lambda API + Cron)
#
#  Deploy:
#    cd keeper-ephemeral-chat-backend
#    serverless deploy --stage prod
#
#  Serverless v4 features:
#    - Built-in esbuild for TypeScript bundling (no serverless-esbuild plugin needed)
#    - Native SDK v3 support


service: keepr-ephemeral-chat

frameworkVersion: "4"


# CUSTOM  – change these values if you need different names

custom:
  # Feature 1 – Vault
  vaultBucketName: keepr-vault-storage-anshul

  # Feature 2 – Link Detonator
  detonatorBucketName: keepr-detonator-storage
  detonatorFunctionName: KeeprLinkDetonator
  detonatorMemoryMB: 1600
  detonatorTimeoutSec: 60

  # Feature 3 – Chat
  connectionsTable: ${self:service}-connections-${sls:stage}

  # Feature 4 – Secure Cloud Storage Room
  secureRoomBucketName: keepr-secure-rooms-${sls:stage}
  roomSettingsTableName: keepr-room-settings-${sls:stage}
  roomApiGatewayName: keepr-room-api-${sls:stage}


# PROVIDER

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-south-1

  # WebSocket API for Feature 3
  websocketsApiName: keepr-chat-api
  websocketsApiRouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  environment:
    # Feature 3 – chat Lambda functions need this env var
    CONNECTIONS_TABLE: ${self:custom.connectionsTable}
    
    # Feature 4 – Secure Room functions need these env vars
    SECURE_ROOM_BUCKET: ${self:custom.secureRoomBucketName}
    ROOM_SETTINGS_TABLE: ${self:custom.roomSettingsTableName}
    SENDER_EMAIL: ${env:SENDER_EMAIL, "anshulspotify5@gmail.com"}
    EMAIL_USER: ${env:EMAIL_USER, "anshulspotify5@gmail.com"}
    EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD: ${env:EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD, "cdxmbbvfwqaroqdg"}

  # Built-in esbuild for TypeScript (Serverless v4)
  architecture: arm64  # Optional: use for cost savings on Lambda@Edge, or remove for x86_64

  # IAM role for the chat Lambda functions
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        # Feature 3: send messages back over WebSocket
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - "execute-api:ManageConnections"
          Resource:
            - "arn:aws:execute-api:*:*:**/@connections/*"

        # Feature 3: read/write connection records in DynamoDB
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
          Resource:
            - Fn::GetAtt: [ConnectionsTable, Arn]
            - Fn::Join:
                - "/"
                - - Fn::GetAtt: [ConnectionsTable, Arn]
                  - "index/*"

        # Feature 4: S3 access for Secure Rooms
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:DeleteObject
            - s3:ListBucket
          Resource:
            - "arn:aws:s3:::${self:custom.secureRoomBucketName}"
            - "arn:aws:s3:::${self:custom.secureRoomBucketName}/*"

        # Feature 4: SES access for sending email notifications
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - ses:SendEmail
            - ses:SendRawEmail
          Resource:
            - "arn:aws:ses:${self:provider.region}:*:identity/*"

        # Feature 4: DynamoDB access for Room Settings
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
          Resource:
            - Fn::GetAtt: [RoomSettingsTable, Arn]
            - Fn::Join:
                - "/"
                - - Fn::GetAtt: [RoomSettingsTable, Arn]
                  - "index/*"


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FUNCTIONS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
functions:
  # Feature 3: Ephemeral Chat WebSocket handlers
  connectionHandler:
    handler: handler.connectionHandler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $connect
      - websocket:
          route: $disconnect

  defaultHandler:
    handler: handler.defaultHandler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: $default

  sendMessageHandler:
    handler: handler.sendMessageHandler
    events:
      - websocket:
          route: sendMessage

  # Feature 4: Secure Cloud Storage Room – REST API Handler
  secureRoomApiHandler:
    handler: handlers/secureRoomApi.handler
    timeout: 29
    memorySize: 512
    events:
      # Generate S3 Presigned URLs for upload
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}/upload-url
          method: post
          cors: true

      # Generate S3 Presigned URLs for download
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}/download-url
          method: post
          cors: true

      # Create a new secure room
      - http:
          path: /rooms
          method: post
          cors: true

      # List all secure rooms
      - http:
          path: /rooms
          method: get
          cors: true

      # Get room metadata
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}
          method: get
          cors: true

      # Update room settings
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}
          method: put
          cors: true

      # Delete/dismantle secure room
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}
          method: delete
          cors: true

      # List files in a room
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}/files
          method: get
          cors: true

      # Delete file from a room
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}/files
          method: delete
          cors: true

      # Trigger manual test migration (full lifecycle: migrate → delete S3 → delete DynamoDB → email)
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}/test-migration
          method: post
          cors: true

      # Trigger manual purge-only cleanup (for purge strategy testing without migration)
      - http:
          path: /rooms/{roomId}/trigger-cleanup
          method: post
          cors: true

  # Feature 4: Cron Job – Daily Auto-Deletion & Emergency Handoff
  secureRoomCronJob:
    handler: handlers/secureRoomCron.handler
    timeout: 300
    memorySize: 512
    events:
      # Trigger every 5 minutes – catches expirations within 5 min of their deadline
      - schedule:
          rate: rate(5 minutes)
          enabled: true
          description: "Cleanup and emergency handoff for expired secure rooms (runs every 5 min)"
    environment:
      SENDER_EMAIL: ${env:SENDER_EMAIL, "anshulspotify5@gmail.com"}
      EMAIL_USER: ${env:EMAIL_USER, "anshulspotify5@gmail.com"}
      EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD: ${env:EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD, "cdxmbbvfwqaroqdg"}


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# RESOURCES  –  Pure CloudFormation for all features
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
resources:
  Resources:

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 1 – ZERO-TRUST VAULT
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    VaultBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.vaultBucketName}
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        BucketEncryption:
          ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                SSEAlgorithm: AES256
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedHeaders:
                - "*"
              AllowedMethods:
                - PUT
                - GET
                - POST
                - DELETE
              AllowedOrigins:
                - "http://localhost:3000"
                - "http://localhost:8080"
                - "http://localhost:5173"
                - "https://keeper-app-gold.vercel.app"
                - "https://keepr-4j2p.onrender.com"
              ExposedHeaders: []
              MaxAge: 3000
        LifecycleConfiguration:
          Rules:
            - Id: AutoExpireVaultObjects
              Status: Enabled
              ExpirationInDays: 7

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 2 – LINK DETONATOR
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    DetonatorLambdaRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        RoleName: KeeprDetonatorLambdaRole
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
        ManagedPolicyArns:
          - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: DetonatorReadStagingBucket
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - "s3:GetObject"
                  Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${self:custom.detonatorBucketName}/*"

    DetonatorLambdaFunction:
      Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
      DependsOn:
        - DetonatorLambdaRole
      Properties:
        FunctionName: ${self:custom.detonatorFunctionName}
        Runtime: nodejs20.x
        Role: !GetAtt DetonatorLambdaRole.Arn
        Handler: index.handler
        MemorySize: ${self:custom.detonatorMemoryMB}
        Timeout: ${self:custom.detonatorTimeoutSec}
        Code:
          S3Bucket: ${self:custom.detonatorBucketName}
          S3Key: lambda-detonator.zip

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 3 – EPHEMERAL CHAT
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    ConnectionsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:custom.connectionsTable}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: connectionId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: roomId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: connectionId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: RoomIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: roomId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput:
              ReadCapacityUnits: 5
              WriteCapacityUnits: 5
        BillingMode: PROVISIONED
        ProvisionedThroughput:
          ReadCapacityUnits: 5
          WriteCapacityUnits: 5
        TimeToLiveSpecification:
          AttributeName: ttl
          Enabled: true

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # FEATURE 4 – SECURE CLOUD STORAGE ROOM
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    # S3 Bucket for Secure Rooms
    SecureRoomBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.secureRoomBucketName}
        PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
          BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        BucketEncryption:
          ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
            - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                SSEAlgorithm: AES256
        CorsConfiguration:
          CorsRules:
            - AllowedHeaders:
                - "*"
              AllowedMethods:
                - PUT
                - GET
                - POST
                - DELETE
              AllowedOrigins:
                - "http://localhost:3000"
                - "http://localhost:8080"
                - "http://localhost:5173"
                - "https://keeper-app-gold.vercel.app"
                - "https://keepr-4j2p.onrender.com"
              ExposedHeaders:
                - ETag
              MaxAge: 3000
        # Objects expire based on room expiry (handled by Lambda cron)
        LifecycleConfiguration:
          Rules:
            - Id: DeleteExpiredRoomObjects
              Status: Enabled
              ExpirationInDays: 30
              NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 1

    # DynamoDB Table for Room Settings
    RoomSettingsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:custom.roomSettingsTableName}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: roomId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: createdAt
            AttributeType: N
          - AttributeName: ownerId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: expiryTimestamp
            AttributeType: N
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: roomId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: OwnerIdIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: ownerId
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: createdAt
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput:
              ReadCapacityUnits: 5
              WriteCapacityUnits: 5
          - IndexName: ExpiryIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: expiryTimestamp
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
            ProvisionedThroughput:
              ReadCapacityUnits: 5
              WriteCapacityUnits: 5
        BillingMode: PROVISIONED
        ProvisionedThroughput:
          ReadCapacityUnits: 5
          WriteCapacityUnits: 5
        TimeToLiveSpecification:
          AttributeName: ttl
          Enabled: true
        StreamSpecification:
          StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES


  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # OUTPUTS
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Outputs:
    SecureRoomBucketName:
      Description: "S3 Bucket for Secure Rooms"
      Value: !Ref SecureRoomBucket
      Export:
        Name: ${self:service}-secure-room-bucket-${sls:stage}

    RoomSettingsTableName:
      Description: "DynamoDB Table for Room Settings"
      Value: !Ref RoomSettingsTable
      Export:
        Name: ${self:service}-room-settings-table-${sls:stage}

    SecureRoomApiEndpoint:
      Description: "REST API Endpoint for Secure Rooms"
      Value: !Sub 'https://\${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.\${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${sls:stage}'
      Export:
        Name: ${self:service}-api-endpoint-${sls:stage}

serviceProviderAwsCfStackOutputs.Description: REST API Endpoint for Secure Rooms
